name: Pilgrimage Church of St John of Nepomuk at Zelená Hora
description: On a hilltop near Žďár nad Sázavou, on the Moravian side of the old border with Bohemia, stands a church shaped like a five-pointed star. Jan Santini Aichel designed it in the early 1700s to honour St John of Nepomuk, and it was his last work. Its Gothic-flavoured Baroque forms, with the number five repeated throughout, make it one of Central Europe's strangest pilgrimage churches.
